record.viewport: 390 CSS px wide phone, dark mode
record.summary: Apart from the accepted deviations, the render matches the reference, and each deviation appears in the render as its description says.

accepted_deviations.as_given: Panels. The Overview tab shows the Inbox, Queue and Context drift panels (R5, R6, R9) and no Chats panel: that is NCC-130's next PR (Chats, with its pager; LIBRARY_GAPS.md).
accepted_deviations.note: The Chats panel, its search field, filter chips and pager are not in the render. The page below Context drift is empty background down to the tab bar.

accepted_deviations.as_given: Context drift. ncc check gives one line of text for each finding, with no repository and no kind, so the panel has a row for each finding (3 here) where the frame groups 22 findings by repository with a count and a chevron. The line over the rows says when the check ran and what it reads ("Checked 12m ago. Folder layout and hooks."), where the frame has a clock time and other checks ("AGENTS.md length, links and folder layout"), which wait for a later check. The heading is PageHeader at its pane size, as Inbox and Queue are.
accepted_deviations.note: The render shows three plain text rows with no count or chevron, the heading count is 3 and the line over the rows reads "Checked 12m ago. Folder layout and hooks."

accepted_deviations.as_given: Queue. "In progress" lists the open PRs with their pills, and no priority mark or owner chat on a row ("the-bridge#535" without "· bridge-workbench"): both come from Linear, which is out of scope. There is no "Up next" group, so the Queue counts its open PRs: 3 where the frame says 8, and "In progress" 3 where the frame says 4 over three rows.
accepted_deviations.note: The rows have no priority bars, so their titles start at the panel's left padding and wrap at other words. There is no owner chat on a row and no Up next group. The counts are Queue 3 and In progress 3.

accepted_deviations.as_given: To review. The group shows as the frame draws it, closed with 17. On the live page it is empty until backend-coord decides how a chat's Inbox item names its project.
accepted_deviations.note: "TO REVIEW 17" is closed, with a right chevron.

accepted_deviations.as_given: Panel headings. "Inbox" and "Queue" are PageHeader at its pane size (15 px, the count in mono), where the frame has an 18/24 heading and a 13 px count: no text style is 18 px (LIBRARY_GAPS.md).
accepted_deviations.note: The panel headings are smaller than the frame's, and each count is in mono.

accepted_deviations.as_given: Panel border. Each panel heading sits where the frame draws it, 20 under the tabs, but its panel starts 2 px lower than the frame's (the Inbox panel's top border at y 310 where the frame has 308): the frame puts the panel 14 under the 44 px heading row, which no spacing token has, so it is 16 (LIBRARY_GAPS.md, Spacing 14).
accepted_deviations.note: The Inbox heading is at about y 271 in both images, and the panel top is about 2 px lower in the render.

accepted_deviations.as_given: Row height. The Inbox and Queue rows are 72 px apart where the frame's are 74, so each panel is 2 px shorter for each row and the closed "To review" row ends higher: the library's compact ListRow with phone sides is 72 high (LIBRARY_GAPS.md, Compact list row 74 on the phone).
accepted_deviations.note: In the render, the Inbox rows start at about y 381, 453 and 525, and TO REVIEW is at about y 603 where the frame has 607.

accepted_deviations.as_given: Panel gap. One panel over the other, they are 24 apart where the frame has 28, which no spacing token has (LIBRARY_GAPS.md).
accepted_deviations.note: The gaps between the panels are slightly smaller than the frame's.

accepted_deviations.as_given: Tabs. The tab row shows Overview, Repositories, QA and Ideas, where the frame shows Overview, Repositories, Architecture and QA: only the tabs of shipped increments show (d-133). Repositories is increment two's live slice, QA increment three's and Ideas increment one's. So QA sits where the frame draws Architecture, and Ideas where it draws QA.
accepted_deviations.note: QA is third and Ideas is fourth, cut at the right edge.

accepted_deviations.as_given: Quick chat shows as the frame draws it; no frame draws its composer, so it is the library Dialog on every size, and in a state it opens nothing.
accepted_deviations.note: The Quick chat button at the top right matches the frame.

accepted_deviations.as_given: Owner's name. NCC-1701's purpose starts "The owner's personal workspace", where the frame has the owner's name: the secret scan's personal-term rule keeps the name out of web/, so the purpose breaks its lines at other words. The live page shows the brain's own words.
accepted_deviations.note: The purpose reads "The owner's personal workspace for thinking, learning, managing projects and directing AI agents, plus the shared template for new projects." on four lines.

accepted_deviations.as_given: Name size. The name is the 28 px heading, where the frame draws 24, which no text style has (LIBRARY_GAPS.md, Phone page title 24), so it is wider and its line ends 4 px lower.
accepted_deviations.note: "NCC-1701" is larger and wider than the frame's.

accepted_deviations.as_given: Picture. The picture is 64 px square, as on T01b and D01, where this frame draws 56, which no size token has (LIBRARY_GAPS.md, Project picture 56). The name and the purpose keep the frame's 16 px gap, so they start 8 px right of the frame's.
accepted_deviations.note: The N picture is larger, and the name and purpose start about 8 px further right.

accepted_deviations.as_given: Tab padding. The selected tab is the library's large item tab, 4 px wider than the frame's and 2 px further in from the page's edge (LIBRARY_GAPS.md, Phone item tabs).
accepted_deviations.note: The selected Overview tab is slightly wider and starts slightly further in.

accepted_deviations.as_given: Tab row. The four tabs run past the right edge, as the frame's row of five does, and the row scrolls.
accepted_deviations.note: Ideas is cut at the right edge.

accepted_deviations.as_given: Tab bar. The tab bar is the app's shared one in the default order (d-105): Home, Inbox, Workspaces, Projects and More. The frame draws Inbox, Workspaces, Projects and More.
accepted_deviations.note: The tab bar shows Home, Inbox, Workspaces, Projects and More, with Projects selected.

limits: The images were viewed at about 390x2560 and may have been scaled down for display. Differences under about 2 px could not be measured reliably, and no region crops were given.
The QA tab's icon (a small filled triangle) could not be compared because the frame does not show a QA tab in view.
